# scc_app_retention_compliance_rule (Resource)

Manages the AppRetentionComplianceRule object via New-AppRetentionComplianceRule / Get-AppRetentionComplianceRule / Set-AppRetentionComplianceRule / Remove-AppRetentionComplianceRule.
